title: Apps not responding while BG is changing. Had to press run now
symptom: AAPS did not respond for 20 minutes, requiring manual press of 'run now' to resume. It worked for a few hours then happened again. Later, the user experienced 15 minutes of loop not responding.
cause: The thread does not definitively establish a root cause. A maintainer suggested that AUTOSENS logging is huge and causes fast log rotation, which may be related, but the user also suspected the app might be killed/suspended by Android due to battery saving, though they had that option off. The user eventually resolved by reinstalling the app.
fix: The maintainer advised to turn off AUTOSENS logging. The user also reinstalled the app, which solved the problem temporarily. No definitive fix was confirmed.
evidence_quote: TURN OFF AUTOSENS logging. it's huge and it's causing fast log rotation
